specialRules.ruleFull: The warband may hire hired swords as if it were a Human Mercenary warband.
Warriors within 6" of the Vampire Hunter may use his Leadership instead of their own.
The Vampire Hunter hates Vampires. He must always move towards a Vampire he can see, unless he can shoot, when he may choose.
A Slayer hates Vampires. He must always move towards a Vampire he can see, unless he can shoot, when he may choose.
The Priest of Morr may carry only a dagger and a scythe as weapons, and may never wear armour.
The Priest of Morr never takes All Alone tests.
The Priest of Morr is not a wizard, but starts with one Funerary Rite rolled at random.

fighters.name: Wolfhound
fighters.equipment: None. A Wolfhound never uses or needs weapons or armour.

specialRules.ruleFull: Wolfhounds are animals and gain no experience.
Pilgrims automatically pass every Leadership-based test they take. A Pilgrim may never become the leader.
Pilgrims use no bladed or ranged weapons, only maces, hammers and staffs, and the silver-tip stake.

skillGroup.name: Vampire Hunters of Sylvania
skillGroup.note: Iron Will and Righteous Aura: the Vampire Hunter and Slayers only.

specialSkillsList.name: Iron Will
specialSkillsList.description: The warrior is immune to fear.

specialSkillsList.name: Thirst for Vengeance
specialSkillsList.description: The warrior hates all Undead, and has +1 Attack in a turn he charges.

specialSkillsList.name: Blessing of Morr
specialSkillsList.description: The warrior has +1 to all his injury rolls against Undead.

specialSkillsList.name: Touch of Darkness
specialSkillsList.description: Vampire Hunter and Slayers only. The warrior ignores darkness penalties.

flags.what: The warband is the issue's pages 9 to 13 (Letters of the Damned #5); the rest of the issue is other articles.
A Slayer warband needs at least 3 models: our templates hold no minimum, so it is not imported. No maximum is printed, so the warriors take our Human race.
Choice of Warriors allows up to four Pilgrims and up to four Wolfhounds, but their headings (p12) read 0-5. Choice of Warriors is taken: 0-4 each.

The special skills are a new group, Vampire Hunters of Sylvania. The Vampire Hunter and Slayers may take them all; the Priest of Morr only Blessing of Morr (printed "Blessing of Moor") and Thirst for Vengeance ("Thirst of Vengeance" in the heading line), so Touch of Darkness opens with "Vampire Hunter and Slayers only", and the group's note says it of Iron Will and Righteous Aura, which other groups share. Righteous Aura is our Righteous Aura, the Sisters of Sigmar's skill once named Sign of Sigmar (William, 6 Nov 2026: "yes but rename to righteous aura as the base"). Iron Will (immune to fear) is one skill with the Protectorate of Sigmar's Unshakeable Faith, named Iron Will in both groups ("yes go for iron will").
The skill table, read from the layout text: Vampire Hunter all six; Slayer Combat, Shooting, Strength, Speed, Special; Priest of Morr Academic, Speed, Special.
The Crossbow Pistol line (15 gc) carries an asterisk with no footnote; it is our Crossbow pistol at the printed 15 gc.

Stubs: the Scythe (10 gc, Common; close combat, Strength as user +1, two-handed), the Silver-tip Stake (Common; close combat, Strength as user, Heart-seeker: +1 to the injury roll when it wounds; its entry says 15 gc, the lists 10 gc, taken from the lists) and the Throat Guard (10 gc, Rare 7, Life Saver: a special 6+ save against every injury roll a Vampire causes, not modified by Strength but lost to criticals that ignore armour; adds no armour save, worn alone or with light or heavy armour). Blessed Bolts ("See Protectorate of Sigmar") is the Protectorate's stub, one item with a price for both warbands. Holy Water (10 gc here, 5 gc for the Protectorate) is our Blessed Water, shown as Holy Water (William, 6 Nov 2026: "yes").
"Spear (Pitch Fork)" on the Villager list is our Spear, shown as Pitch Fork.

The Priest of Morr "may only be armed with a Dagger and a Scythe" and never armour: his own list holds the two at the Vampire Hunters list's prices, and he buys from the Heroes' Miscellaneous list too.

Funerary Rites differ from ours in their Difficulties (Sanctity of the Fallen 5, ours 7; Do you know who I am? 9, ours 7; I am death! 7, ours 8): a new lore, Funerary Rites (Vampire Hunters of Sylvania).
